name: change-factory
description: Run a list of changes to a working system as parallel workstreams: owner decisions, briefs, cheap coding workers in rounds, independent reviews, merges onto one integration branch, one red team per risky stream on the merged code, and a release in which every deploy, push and owner record is the owner's own yes. A helper script keeps the run's event log and refuses steps whose gates are not met; workers run auto-approved under deny rules that are not a sandbox.
